title: Framework Configuration
description: Unified control for GsCore system service, runtime, database engine, media hosting, and messaging
noConfigItems: This config group has no parameter items

systemCore.networkCardHelp: Configure GsCore Web/WS listener host and port, authentication tokens, session concurrency, and CORS origins. Most network changes require a restart.
systemCore.authCardHelp: Manage master (pm=0) and superuser (pm=1) account IDs alongside global bot command prefix rules.
systemCore.lowLevelCardHelp: Configure low-level config.json log channels, scheduler misfire tolerance, and fallback background artwork.

search.noMatchDesc: Try another keyword or clear the filter to browse progressive sections
search.resultSummary: Matched {count} fields across {groups} groups — edit directly below

progressive.moreFieldsHelp: Additional or newly registered backend fields preserved for full forward compatibility.
progressive.partialLoadWarning: Some config groups failed to load ({names}); remaining sections can still be edited safely.

runtime.envCardHelp: Select the Python environment manager used to launch and restart GsCore. Enable a custom restart command only for specialized container or supervisor setups.
runtime.venvFieldHelp: Auto detects the active environment manager in your working directory; uv is recommended for new deployments.
runtime.customRestartHelp: Overrides the built-in restart routine with a custom shell command. Incorrect commands may prevent GsCore from coming back online.
runtime.scheduleCardHelp: Schedule daily core updates, plugin updates, and off-peak restarts; time pickers appear progressively when each task is enabled.
runtime.pluginCardHelp: Control live code reloading during development and automatic Python dependency synchronization.
runtime.extraCoreHelp: Low-level runtime options such as Git mirror prefixes, buffered user writes, and framework aliases.
runtime.logCardHelp: Configure console and file log thresholds and retention windows; INFO is recommended for production.

database.engineCardHelp: Built-in SQLite delivers great single-node performance out of the box; switch to PostgreSQL or MySQL for multi-node or high-concurrency deployments. Restart GsCore after changing engines.
database.sqliteReadyBanner: Using built-in SQLite storage (data/GsData.db) — zero external setup required
database.sqliteCacheHelp: Negative values specify KiB (e.g. -64000 ≈ 64 MB RAM page cache), reducing disk read overhead.
database.sqliteSyncHelp: NORMAL balances crash safety with high write throughput; OFF maximizes speed at the risk of losing recent commits on power loss.
database.advancedCardHelp: Tune async connection pool sizing, idle connection recycling, and verbose SQL query logging.
database.echoHelp: Enable temporarily when diagnosing slow queries or ORM issues; produces heavy log output in production.

media.conflictTitle: Remote Link Mode Requires Image Hosting
media.conflictDesc: {platforms} ({count} adapters) use external URL delivery while Image Hosting is disabled.
media.uploadCardHelp: Converts generated images into publicly accessible URLs for official bot platforms that reject raw files or large Base64 payloads.
media.picSrvCollapsedHint: Image hosting is currently disabled; leave off if all adapters send via Base64.
media.localPicSrvUrlLabel: Public Base URL for Built-in Image Server
media.enableCleanLabel: Periodically Clean Expired Local Image Cache
media.autoDeleteLabel: Delete Remote Temporary Image Immediately After Delivery
media.sendMatrixHelp: **Base64**: universal & port-free; **Local File**: fastest when Bot and Core share a filesystem; **Remote URL / Auto Link**: required for URL-only official APIs.
media.imageGenCardHelp: Configure rendering quality, fonts, and headless browser pool parameters.

interaction.miscCardHelp: Configure @mention placement, built-in help theme, merged forward message behavior, and per-user rate limits.
interaction.blacklistPlaceholder: Enter user or group ID and press Enter…
interaction.richMediaCardHelp: Enable native Markdown, interactive inline buttons, and approved template payloads per bot platform.
interaction.mdPlatformLabel: Platforms Allowed to Send Native Markdown
interaction.btnPlatformLabel: Platforms Allowed to Send Interactive Buttons
interaction.compatCardHelp: Fine-tune CRLF line endings, media/button message splitting, and QQ template fallbacks.

identity.profileCardHelp: Customize the bot display name, aliases, subtitle, and accent color; toggle custom background or avatar to upload artwork inline.
identity.metricsCardHelp: Choose which hardware utilization and session counters are displayed on status cards.
identity.stateMediaCardHelp: Upload custom background artwork or icons for status cards.
identity.verifyCardHelp: Connect a trusted verification API endpoint for plugins requiring challenge resolution.
identity.verifyRiskNotice: Verification gateways handle sensitive challenge tokens — only configure endpoints you own or fully trust.
identity.deprecatedVerifyHelp: Retained strictly for legacy compatibility; keep disabled on standard deployments.
